chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, from Abd Allah ibn al-Mughira, from Sama'ah ibn Mihran, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the one performing Itikaaf who had relations with his wife. He (peace be upon him) said: 'He is in the status of the one who breaks a fast of a day from the month of Ramadan.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for someone who has sexual relations with their spouse while performing Itikaaf?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the ruling for a mu'takif who has sexual intercourse with his spouse, equating the penalty to that of breaking a fast for one day. This comparison highlights the sanctity of the retreat space and time, treating the act as a significant breach of the spiritual state of Itikaaf. The ruling underscores the balance between permissible marital relations and the heightened spiritual discipline required during the retreat.
